spec_findings.title: Unconditional footer asserts disconnected even when connection is unknown or confirmed
static_counterexample: With admitted=true and capability GET rejecting 503, lines39-41/53 display unknown while line64 still says not connected.

With admitted=true and valid available=true/authorized=true capability response, line56 confirms connection/authorization while line64 still says not connected. The validator codexClient.ts:15-18 permits this combination with all three product flags false.
normative_basis: PRODUCT_DESIGN.md:354 makes fallback labeling conditional on unavailable/unauthorized Codex, not unknown observations.
PRODUCT_DESIGN.md:1467 distinguishes bootstrap readiness from independently observed account authorization.
spec_findings.minimum_correction: Describe the local action, e.g. this local document does not call Codex, and let the existing fresh observation own current connection status; cover unknown and authorized responses in ordinary unit tests.
spec_findings.verification: STATIC_ONLY; deterministic render branches inspected, no app/test/browser/DB/network execution.

reviewer_scope: One reviewer separately applied Standards and Spec axes; no parallel-agent independence claim, same thread-capacity limitation as initial review.
safe_output_limits: No test execution credited. No DOM diagnosis reproduction, runtime/account/secret/DB access, remote action or source mutation. Producer-reported native/Web results are outside this receipt.
